title: Exactly homogeneous ball masses determine the density
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), x ∈ ℝ^P, θ ∈ ℝ with θ ≥ 0, and r > 0. Suppose that M_{B_ρ(x)}(T) = ofReal(θ)·(ω_n·ofReal(ρⁿ)) in [0, ∞] for every ρ with 0 < ρ < r, where ω_n = unitBallVolume n is the volume of the unit ball of ℝⁿ. Then HasMassDensity T x θ, i.e. Θⁿ(μ_T, x) = θ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (x : Euclid P) (θ r : ℝ), 0 ≤ θ → 0 < r → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < r → T.massOn (ball x ρ) = ENNReal.ofReal θ * (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n))) → HasMassDensity T x θ
